messages.author: 3fba19f198416383
messages.subject: Problem in analyzing Axivity data
parts:
Hi,
First of all, thanks for creating the GGIR package!
I am using GGIR package to analyze data obtained from AX3 trackers. I have been trying to run the analysis for one week but without any success. When I input the data using the command below, I get to see that there are no errors and the R console displays that 'Part-1' is running. However, it remains in this phase forever and doesn't generate any results. The output folders are created and only metadata is created in the 'meta' folder.

library(GGIR)
GGIR(datadir="C:/Sleep_Data",
             outputdir="D:/myresults")

Could you please tell me what is happening? Why the analysis is stuck?

Thanks & Regards
Shiv

messages.author: 5c488e6ec119b4c1
messages.subject: Re: Problem in analyzing Axivity data
parts:
Hi Shiv,

I work with AX3 devices and GGIR, and am happy to help you troubleshoot this. However, without more information, I think that many here will struggle to understand what may be going on in your circumstance.

What are the restrictions around the data you are working with? Are you able to share an example file so that someone may try to replicate your issue and ultimately help solve it? If not,

1. What version of GGIR are you running?
2. What file type and size are your files?
3. When you say "forever" how long is this? 5 minutes? 1 hour?
4. Have you tried running your process with standard/example data to determine if it is an error in the data compared to the process?

Cheers,
Mark
